violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Equipment in deli kitchen needs to be cleaned. - Fans in meat dept found dirty.
Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. - To go containers found on floor in hallway by deli kitchen.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. - Found empty box in handwash station.
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room used by women did not contain at least one covered waste receptacle.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. - Floors in deli kitchen under equipment found dirty. - Floors in deli walk-ins found dirty.
Ventilation hood systems - Design and construction. — --Ventilation hood system was not provided over all cooking equipment. Rotisserie over not located under the Hood system.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Walk in cooler attached to the kitchen in need of floor being cleaned.
